Name: AhCuteArt's Color Themed Horse Mounts
Author: AhCuteArt
Description:
[b][size=5][center][img]https://ahcreativehub.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Animation-test.gif[/img]﻿AhCuteArt's Colored Theme Project[img]https://ahcreativehub.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Animation-test.gif[/img]﻿[/center][/size][/b]

Hi, everyone! This is another entry for the 2026 SDVModfest. I hope you all enjoy this one. I’ve always liked the horse mods out there, but I wanted to add weird, extreme colors. So my horse retextures are more fantasy-focused.

[b]I redid the horse animation[/b]. I wanted the gallop to look more realistic (within reason), so I referenced footage of horses running. Which was hard to pull off in seven frames, but I think it turned out pretty well.

Different types of mounts will be added as I go, but for now, I have the colored horses and their ghost versions finished. (Honestly, the ghost version turned out better than I expected!)

UPDATE: I added witch brooms. I looked around, and I couldn't find witch broom mounts in different colors, so I decided to add them to my mod. For all of you who enjoy witch core, I hope you like the animations and edits I made. Unfortunately, the sounds do not change. Just think of the broom that thinks it's a horse and makes equestrian sounds (for now.) 

I hope you enjoy this mod, and thank you for taking the time to look it over.




[b]Current Colors: Black, Blue, Red, White, Green, Grey, Orange, Original, Purple, Yellow,  Baby Blue, Buttermilk, Lilac, Marigold, Mint, and Pink
[b]Horse Types: Horse, Ghost, Witch Broom[/b]
[/b][b]
[/b]
[b][size=4]INSTALLATION (Must have Content Patcher): [/size]
[/b]
1. ﻿Choose one of the files or both. (Both the CP and AT files work together or separately) 
2. ﻿Unzip and drag the replacement into your mods folder

[b]
[size=4]There are Two files:[/size][/b]
[b][CP File][/b] This file will change all your horses into a themed single type and color. Go into the GMCM and look for [b](CP) AhCuteArt Color Themed Horse Mounts[/b] to change the color and type of mount you want. 
[b][AT File][/b] This file will change horse into whatever theme and color you want. Make sure to buy the scissors from Robin to be able to edit your mounts. 

[b][size=4]Compatibility:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]This should work in every language. (I hope)
[*]The CP file might clash with other mods that edit the horse, but the AT file will work with anything. 
[/list]

[b][size=4][b][size=4]Extra!:[/size][/b]
[/size][/b][size=3]I retextured the horse running animation. [/size][b][size=4]

Future Plans:[/size][/b]
I am working on adding other types of mounts. Like: Deers, War Hogs, Dragons, Dire Wolves, Slime, Giant Animals, and more. (Let me know if you have any ideas for what to add.)

[/b][i]If there is a color you want or a theme you would like to see done, feel free to request it, and I'll add it when I get the time.  [/i][/i]
